_: Off-season blurbs for the Teams view's form block (app.js renderTeamForm): shown before a season starts and once one is well over. Plain text, one per team slug. Edit freely — nothing generates this file. The six Seattle clubs' blurbs are lqa-events' and everett-events' — keep them in step.
seahawks: Mike Macdonald's third season in charge opens at Lumen Field. Flex-week kickoffs fill in above as the league confirms them.
mariners: Spring training opens in Peoria in February and the regular season in late March; the schedule above fills in once MLB publishes it. Cal Raleigh and Julio Rodríguez remain the core of the lineup.
kraken: A new season at Climate Pledge Arena. The Kraken open on the road and are home within the first week.
storm: Rebuilding around a young core after a hard year; free agency and the draft over the winter will shape the roster before the season opens in May.
reign: The Reign's NWSL season runs March to November at Lumen Field, with the playoffs beyond that for the top eight.
sounders: The Sounders' MLS season runs February to October, with the playoffs beyond that for the top nine in the West.
